head: 3c69f2d

cases.name: Cap-integrity across mixed rebind and clean-turn sequences
cases.evidence: Mixed turn-level rebinds logged lifetime=1 and lifetime=2 while each consecutive budget reset to 1/3; three subsequent consecutive failures advanced epoch to 5, then RebindCapExceededError surfaced with a /new hint.

cases.name: Concurrent ensureSession for one origin while rebind is in flight
cases.evidence: packages/gateway/test/takeover-redteam.test.ts:178 expected both callers to receive session-e1 and one epoch bump; actual Set contained session-e1 and session-e2. The implementation spawned two initial creates, bumped e0->e1 and e1->e2, and minted two sessions.

cases.name: Prose-matching defense for create and turn failures
cases.evidence: Unrelated code unsupported_state_version with either rebind-looking message performed no rebind at create or turn level; epoch and spawn counts remained unchanged.

cases.name: Redaction adversarials for quoted headers, URL/camelCase keys, control splits, and hostile code
cases.evidence: Authorization Bearer 40-hex JSON value, ?apikey query value, apiKey value, control-split value, and sk_live_ plus 60-character hostile code were redacted; hostile notice remained bounded.

cases.name: Replay-side-effect guard after streamed assistant text
cases.evidence: onAssistantText delivered one partial message; managed_append_identity_mismatch caused one rebind and no replay turn spawn, with turn_not_replayed notice and no /new hint.

cases.name: Overlapping SIGHUP and verb reload while a turn is mid-debounce
cases.evidence: Two SIGHUP handlers and one gateway.reloadConfig ran during a 250ms debounce; probes distinguished mentionAllowlist/channels mixtures and observed the complete new policy. A malformed follow-up returned ok:false diagnostics and retained the previous complete policy.

cases.name: terminal_uncertain visibility and independent next classification
cases.evidence: Exactly one log line carried cause=terminal_uncertain epoch 0 -> 1; a later resource_gone failure logged independently as epoch 2 -> 3 and rebound successfully.

blockers.message: Concurrent ensureSession calls double-bump the origin epoch and mint two sessions.

advisories: Gateway chat turns are serialized by KeyedQueue, but direct GjcClient callers (including monitor propagation and future callers) can still reach this race.
